label: completeHandoff throws unless the note's status is exactly claimed, so a claimed note can only be closed by whoever holds it.
noteState accepts exactly missing, invalid, open, claimed and done; there is no expired or abandoned state, so a claim never closed has no representation other than claimed.
Nothing expires a claimed note: the only stale sweeps in the handover code belong to the killer and cover lock files and takeover mutexes.
questionHoldReason blocks a question only while the record is armable, and the Pi extension applies it to the question and ask_user_question tools only, so a prose ask is never blocked.
The Pi receiver asked in prose and deferred the close to an answer that could not arrive, so the guard never fired and the note stayed claimed.
The claim output's completion instruction is conditional on the remaining work being done, so a note whose Remaining work needs an operator answer makes completion unreachable in an unattended run.
The guard's own text already names the correct behaviour, end the turn and put the question in the note or cancel first, and nothing detected that the receiver did neither.
